subject.title: fix(plugins): prevent npm 12 metadata failures from disabling healthy plugins

question: Should this PR be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106189, including both state preservation and the update-check singleton-array normalization, or should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107063 land with the parser change carried separately?
rationale: Both branches are proof-positive and overlap at the compatibility-sensitive plugin update lifecycle, but only this PR includes the sibling update-check parser normalization; automation should not choose or merge competing policy implementations.

options.title: Refresh and land this PR
options.body: Use this branch as the canonical superset, refresh it against current main, and close the competing PR after confirming the focused tests and CLI proof still match.

options.title: Land the competing PR
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107063 for state preservation and separately port or track this PR's singleton-array update-check normalization.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land this PR
recommendation.body: Use this branch as the canonical superset, refresh it against current main, and close the competing PR after confirming the focused tests and CLI proof still match.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history connects this contributor to both the parser and update lifecycle behavior being selected.
